meaning:
ὑπερ-βάλλω
[in LXX: Job.15:11 A (†), Sir.5:7 25:11, al. ;]
1. trans., to throw over or beyond.
2. Intrans., to run beyond. In both senses, metaphorically, to exceed, surpass, transcend: 2Co.3:10 9:14, Eph.1:19 2:7; with genitive obj., Eph.3:19.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.
and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
